privileged_info_for_vlm: The ground station 'New_York_Studio' must have Latitude 40.7128 (North) and Longitude -74.0060 (West). The satellites to be included are ISS (ZARYA) (NORAD 25544) and HST (NORAD 20580). The map must have the shadow enabled but the grid, sun icon, and moon icon disabled. The layout must be 'Map-only'.
